'''Drop Point: Condor''' was the codename of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[drop point]] located in [[System M132L4]]. It was operational for the duration of [[Operation Nighthook]], and specific communications channels were monitored from 0200 to 0600 each [[Standard day/Legends|standard day]]. Alliance [[operative]]s requiring the drop point broadcast on [[comm channel 2588.3]] using [[encryption code T33-A]]. Secondary contact was through [[comm channel 7349.2]] using [[encryption code N21-H]].<ref name="DP" />
